meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并运行量子电路，模拟噪声并部署到谷歌量子硬件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用谷歌量子硬件做低层电路开发或量子表征实验
copy.tagline_en: Design and run quantum circuits, simulate noise, and deploy to Google quantum hardware
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing low-level quantum circuits for Google hardware or running characterization experiments

howto.what: Claude 可以用 Python 代码设计、模拟和运行量子电路，支持参数扫描、噪声建模，并能连接 Google、IonQ 等量子硬件执行任务。
howto.when: 当你需要构建或模拟量子电路、在 Google 量子处理器上运行任务、或进行噪声建模与量子表征实验时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个量子纠缠电路并模拟1000次。
say.note: Claude 会生成 Bell 态电路并输出测量结果直方图。

say.text: 用参数扫描优化一个单量子比特的旋转角度。

howto.what_en: Claude can design, simulate, and run quantum circuits in Python, supporting parameter sweeps, noise modeling, and execution on Google, IonQ, and other quantum hardware.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to build or simulate quantum circuits, run jobs on Google Quantum AI processors, or perform noise modeling and characterization experiments.

say_en.text: Write a quantum entanglement circuit and simulate it 1000 times.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a Bell state circuit and output measurement histograms.

say_en.text: Optimize a single-qubit rotation angle using parameter sweep.
say_en.note: Claude will create a parameterized circuit and run a Linspace sweep.
